story.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：安东内利称周末为“警钟”
story.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在荷兰大奖赛排位赛中仅列第三，错失杆位，此前冲刺赛排位冲出赛道损坏赛车并在冲刺赛中只获第四，他称这个周末是一次“警钟”。

media.altZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：安东内利称周末为“警钟” · 第 1 张

story.originalTitle: Antonelli: F1 Dutch GP weekend has been a "wake-up call"
story.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli qualified only third for the Dutch Grand Prix after going off track in sprint qualifying and finishing fourth in the sprint, calling the weekend a "wake-up call" for the championship leader.
detailZh: 为什么F1荷兰大奖赛周末对安东内利来说是一次"警钟"
这位积分榜领跑者在冲刺赛排位赛中的失误最终让他付出了错失领奖台的代价，而他还觉得另一个失误使他错过了正赛的杆位
安东内利在周日荷兰大奖赛正赛排位赛获得第三名后的表情说明了一切：又一次机会从指间溜走了。
对这个积分榜领跑者来说，这是一个不太理想的周末：他在冲刺赛排位赛中冲出赛道导致赛车受损，最终只能以第四名完成冲刺赛。随后他觉得自己本应拿下周日正赛（计分赛）的杆位，但在最后一个排位飞驰圈的开端没有足够用力地推进。
"我认为这个周末在夏休期之后给我们敲了一个很好的警钟，就是你绝不能放松警惕," 他在排位赛后说道。
"所以，这是一次很好的警钟，尤其是着眼于接下来的几场比赛。"
赞德沃特狭窄、起伏的赛道布局加上带横向坡度的弯道组合，使得超车非常困难，因此排位赛在这个场地尤为重要。在冲刺赛排位赛的第一节中，安东内利在倒数第二个弯Kumhobocht的入弯处推得太狠，冲出赛道碾过了砂石区。
这损坏了他赛车的底板，估计损失了25个单位的下压力。由于更换整个底板是一项非常耗时的工作，他在接下来的整个阶段中不得不一直承受这个后果。
因此，安东内利表现出色，在冲刺赛排位赛中拿到第五名，随后超越了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦，升至第四位。但尽管皮亚斯特里的队友兰多·诺里斯因后轮衰退而从第二掉到第三，他仍未能进一步提升名次。
随后，大奖赛的最终排位赛由降雨主导。当天早些时候的大雨清洗了赛道表面，这意味着随着更多橡胶层被铺设，排位赛过程中的圈速会越来越快。对更多降雨的预期也影响了各车队在最终排位赛中的策略。
通常情况下，赛道在排位赛的最后一刻速度最快。但由于预报显示结束前五分钟会下雨，大多数车队让车手提前出场进行最后一轮飞行圈。
由于赞德沃特的赛道布局使车辆左侧轮胎承受更多能量，大多数车手发现在飞行圈之前需要多跑一圈额外的轮胎准备圈，以使两侧轮胎都达到工作温度。即便如此，在冲刺圈开始时驶入第一个弯角时，轮胎状态仍可能不完全理想。
鉴于最后一个排位赛段开始下雨，只有法拉利坚持了这一做法，而其他车队则指示车手采取常规方式，即只跑一个准备圈后才开始做冲刺圈。
“说实话，我在整个节中都为赛车的平衡感到挣扎，”安东内利说。
“主要是第三计时段，我在减速弯里很挣扎。然后做了一些调整，感觉就回来了。”
“但显然，在最后一圈我在第一计时段犯了个错误。看到面罩上有雨，我跑得有点太保守了，结果第一计时段跑得很差。很遗憾，因为我觉得我们本来有机会争夺杆位。”
赞德福特（Zandvoort）的一号弯具有挑战性，因为入弯前赛道会向下倾斜，使得判断刹车时机变得更加困难，但弯道本身的路面倾斜角度对车手是有利的。周六排位赛期间，不确定的轮胎温度、越来越潮湿的赛道表面以及阵阵逆风，让判断刹车力度的过程变得更加复杂。
对比遥测数据表明，安东内利（Antonelli）比最终夺得杆位的迈凯伦车手诺里斯（Norris）更早松开油门并提前刹车。安东内利也很早就松开了刹车，这表明他在那时已经意识到自己判断失误了。
与安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）相比，诺里斯在一号弯也损失了一些时间，而拉塞尔最终获得排位第二。不过诺里斯在圈速的其他路段弥补了更多时间，反超了拉塞尔的优势，而安东内利在三号弯推进过猛，略微跑宽，削弱了他在圈速其他路段挽回时间的机会。
他比诺里斯慢了0.133秒，将从发车区第三位起步。
“在第一节自由练习赛中我感觉非常好，”安东内利谈到他的这个周末时说。“然后显然昨天在[冲刺赛]排位赛中我犯了一个错误，这肯定让我失去了一些信心。
另外，在今天今天的排位赛中，主要是因为与赛车的感觉不太到位，我仍然很难找到自己的节奏并跑出连贯的圈速。但幸运的是，在Q3中我们能够把一些东西更好地整合起来，最终排在了第二排。
安东内利目前以224分领跑车手总冠军，法拉利车队的刘易斯·汉密尔顿以171分位居第二。他会铭记这样的事实：去年的这个时候，皮亚斯特里曾以309分领先诺里斯的275分位居积分榜榜首，马克斯·维斯塔潘以205分排名第三。皮亚斯特里此后再没有赢得任何一场大奖赛，最终只获得了年度第三名。
detailEn: Why the F1 Dutch GP weekend has been a "wake-up call" for Kimi Antonelli
The championship leader's mistake in sprint qualifying ultimately cost a podium finish, and he felt another error meant he missed out on pole position for the main race
Kimi Antonelli's face after qualifying third for Sunday's final Dutch Grand Prix said it all: another opportunity had slipped away.

It has been a less than optimal weekend for the championship leader after an off-track excursion in sprint qualifying damaged his car, ultimately consigning him to fourth in that race. He then felt he should have been on pole position for Sunday's main points-paying race, but didn't push hard enough at the beginning of his final qualifying lap.
"I think this weekend has been a great wake-up call after the summer break, that you can never let your guard down," he said after qualifying.
"So, it was a good wake-up call, especially looking ahead to the next ones [races]."

Zandvoort's narrow, undulating layout with a mix of cambered corners militates against overtaking so qualifying is especially important at this venue. In the first segment of sprint qualifying Antonelli pushed too hard at the entry to Kumhobocht, the penultimate corner, and ran wide over the gravel.

That damaged the underfloor of his car and cost an estimated 25 points of downforce. He then had to live with the consequences throughout the rest of the session because changing an entire floor is a time-consuming job.

Antonelli therefore did well to qualify fifth for the sprint, then passed Oscar Piastri's McLaren for fourth place. But he was unable to make further progress despite Piastri's team-mate Lando Norris suffering with rear-tyre degradation and dropping back from second to third late on.

Final qualifying for the grand prix was then defined by rain. Heavy showers earlier in the day had cleaned the track surface, dictating that laptimes would get much quicker over the course of qualifying as more rubber was laid down. The expectation of more rain then influenced the teams' approaches to final qualifying.
Usually, the track is at its fastest at the very end of the qualifying hour. But with rain forecast five minutes before the end, most teams sent their drivers out early for their final runs.

Since Zandvoort's layout puts more energy through the tyres on the left-hand side of the car, most drivers found they had to build an extra tyre-preparation lap into their runs to bring both sides up to operating temperature. Even then it was possible to arrive at the first corner on the push lap with them not quite in the right place.

Given the onset of rain in the final qualifying segment, only Ferrari stuck to this approach while the other teams directed their drivers to take the conventional approach of doing just one lap before starting to push.
"I was struggling with the balance, to be fair, throughout the whole session," said Antonelli.
"Mainly Sector 3, I was struggling in the chicane. And then just made a couple of changes and the feeling came back.

"But obviously, in the last lap I did a mistake in Sector 1. I took it a bit too easy seeing the rain on the visor and just, yeah, was a really poor Sector 1. And shame because I think we had a shot for pole."

Zandvoort's first corner is challenging in that it dips down on the approach, making it more difficult to judge the braking, but the corner itself is then cambered in the driver's favour. During qualifying on Saturday the process of judging brake effort was complicated further by uncertain tyre temperatures, the increasingly damp track surface, and a gusting headwind.

Comparing the telemetry data indicates Antonelli lifted off the throttle and braked slightly earlier for the corner than McLaren's Norris, who ultimately took pole position. Antonelli was also very early to release the brakes, suggesting he knew at this point that he had misjudged it.

Norris also lost some time in Turn 1 compared with Antonelli's teammate George Russell, who went on to qualify second. But while Norris recouped more time elsewhere on the lap to overturn Russell's advantage, Antonelli pushed too hard into Turn 3 and ran slightly wide, blunting his chances of making up time elsewhere on the lap.
He fell 0.133s short of Norris and will start third on the grid.
"In FP1 I felt very good," Antonelli said of his weekend. "Then obviously yesterday in [sprint] quali I did a mistake, and that definitely took some confidence away.

"Also, today in qualifying, mainly because the feeling was not really there with the car, I still struggled to find my rhythm and to put the lap times together. But luckily in Q3 we were able to put things a bit more together and to be on the second row."

Antonelli leads the drivers' championship on 224 points, with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton second on 171. He will be mindful of the fact that at this point last year Piastri led the standings with 309 points to Norris's 275, with Max Verstappen third on 205. Piastri didn't win another GP and went on to finish third.

detailZh: 阿尔派的2024年F1赛车部件即将变身终极收藏品展示。F1 Authentics，F1的官方纪念品平台，将开始拍卖一个2024年赛事使用的变速箱载体，配以带有工作DRS襟翼的赛事规格后翼，安装在定制的展示架上。
从阿尔派 2024年Formula 1赛车中使用的变速箱载体被配对了一个带有工作DRS襟翼的赛事规格后翼，形成了一个不同寻常的收藏品展示。
赛车文化不仅限于赛道。它包括车手的生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计以及那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
阿尔派 2024年Formula 1赛车的一部分即将进行拍卖，并且已经被改造成可以放在你客厅的东西。
F1 Authentics，F1官方纪念品平台，正在开启对一款非常酷的2024年赛事使用的变速箱载体以及与其配套的赛车规格后翼的竞拍。变速箱载体上仍保留着其原始的FIA封印，而该翼保留了可工作的DRS襟翼。
这可能会成为你在凝视窗外，一边喝着早晨的咖啡一边沉思时可以依靠的不可思议的东西。
这个组合，是‘奥斯汀拍卖’的一部分，标题为BWT 阿尔派 Formula 1 Team 2024 Race-Used Gearbox Carrier & Rear Wing Assembly。其中只有变速箱载体被描述为赛事使用，而后翼是赛车规格部件。
由碳纤维和金属制成，变速箱载体构成了汽车后结构的一部分，而其上方的翼，仍然保持着阿尔派的粉色和蓝色BWT涂装，并在翼尖上印有Castrol品牌，负责管理空气流动并在汽车后部产生下压力。
DRS襟翼仍然可以打开和关闭。当你有访客时，这将是一场令人难以置信的展示。
埃斯蒂班·奥康，阿尔派，皮埃尔·加斯利，阿尔派
虽然2024年对阿尔派来说并不是一个完美的赛季，但它确实为当时的全法阵容带来了双料领奖台。
在艰难的开局之后，车队在车手积分榜上排名第六，得益于圣保罗大奖赛上的雨战，埃斯蒂班·奥康获得第二名，皮埃尔·加斯利获得第三名。
detailEn: Alpine's 2024 F1 car has been turned into the ultimate collector's display
A race-used gearbox carrier from Alpine's 2024 Formula 1 car has been paired with a race-spec rear wing featuring a working DRS flap for an unusual collector's display
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
A piece of Alpine's 2024 Formula 1 car is about to go up for auction, and it has been turned into something you could actually put in your living room.

F1 Authentics, the official memorabilia platform of F1, is opening bidding on a very cool 2024 race-used gearbox carrier paired with a race-spec rear wing, mounted together on a custom-built display stand. The gearbox carrier still carries its original FIA seal, and the wing keeps a working DRS flap.
It could make for an incredible thing to lean on while you look soulfully out of the window drinking your morning coffee.

The lot, that makes up part of 'The Austin Auction,' is titled the BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team 2024 Race-Used Gearbox Carrier & Rear Wing Assembly. Only the gearbox carrier is described as race-used; the rear wing is a race-specification part.

Made from carbon fibre and metal, the gearbox carrier forms part of the car's rear structure while the wing above it, still in Alpine's pink-and-blue BWT livery with Castrol branding on the endplates, manages airflow and creates downforce at the rear of the car.
The DRS flap can still be opened and closed. And what an incredible showing that would be for when you have visitors.
Esteban Ocon, Alpine, Pierre Gasly, Alpine
While 2024 wasn't the perfect season for Alpine, it did result in a double podium for the then-all-French lineup.
After a difficult start, the team finished sixth in the constructors' standings, helped by a wet race at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, where Esteban Ocon finished second and Pierre Gasly third.

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿的巴西大奖赛帽子揭幕，发布日期确认
法拉利为刘易斯·汉密尔顿揭幕了一款特别的巴西主题帽子，他将佩戴这款帽子参加2026年的巴西大奖赛
法拉利车迷们。最新的法拉利F1车队新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
法拉利揭幕了一款巴西主题帽子，刘易斯·汉密尔顿将在巴西大奖赛中佩戴，粉丝们可以在比赛前几天购买自己的帽子。
Maranello车队与Puma在10月16日通过Instagram联合发布了这款帽子。"莱维斯将在Interlagos赛道上戴上带着一小块巴西元素的帽子。而且它很快也将属于你。将于11月3日开始发售，"车队在展示七届冠军戴着新设计的帽子的照片时写道。
这款帽子以大胆的黄色为主题，细节处有磨损效果，露出下面的绿色，反映了巴西国旗的颜色。法拉利标志以银色突出地放置在前面，与银色的Puma标志相匹配，缝制在帽檐右侧。
"给我来一顶吧，莱维斯先生，"一位粉丝评论道，另一位粉丝补充说："我甚至不是法拉利的粉丝，但这真的很酷。我也想戴。"
其他人质疑这款帽子是否是法拉利车手将在Interlagos赛事中引入类似特殊头盔的信号。
汉密尔顿于2022年11月正式成为巴西的荣誉公民。
"我想对在这里的每一个人说声大大的谢谢，对于那些为了让这一天成为可能而搬山填海的人，" 41岁的汉密尔顿当时说。"这对我来说真的是一种巨大的荣誉，能够在这里接受和接受这个公民身份。我真的感觉现在我是你们中的一员，终于。
"当我2007年第一次来到这里[汉密尔顿的第一个F1赛季]，这里的爱是如何增长的，我们共同的经历，尤其是2021年[他向胜利发起冲击]，知道你们一直在我身后为我加油，这是我一生中最特别的时刻之一。我迫不及待地想要继续努力向前。
"我真的很想将今天，这个荣誉，献给埃尔顿·塞纳——献给埃尔顿的家庭，他的朋友和他的粉丝。对我来说，当我五岁的时候，我第一次看到埃尔顿赛车，那就是我知道我想要成为世界冠军，就像他一样。
“那时我才知道并了解了巴西。那时我开始以巴西队的身份玩FIFA！但实际上，通过他的眼睛，我看到了巴西人有多么热情，这种热爱和激情有多深，你对国家的热爱有多么美好。我非常兴奋能在这里多待一些时间。”
2026年巴西大奖赛将于11月6日至8日举行，这将是一个三连赛的一部分，从10月23日至25日的美国大奖赛开始，接着是10月30日至11月1日的墨西哥大奖赛。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton's Brazilian GP cap unveiled with release date confirmed
Ferrari has unveiled a special Brazil-themed cap for Lewis Hamilton to wear at the 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has revealed a Brazil-themed cap that Lewis Hamilton will wear at the Brazilian Grand Prix, and fans will be able to buy their own a few days before the race.

The Maranello outfit announced the cap in a joint Instagram post with Puma on 16 October. "Lewis will be wearing a small piece of Brazil with him at Interlagos. And it can also be yours soon. Available to buy on November 3rd," the team wrote alongside photos of the seven-time champion wearing the new design.

The cap features a bold yellow theme with distressed detailing that reveals green underneath, reflecting the colours of the Brazilian flag. The Ferrari logo is prominently placed on the front in silver, with a matching silver Puma logo embroidered on the front right of the bill.
"Give me one right now, Sir Lewis Hamilton," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm not even a Ferrari fan, but that is slick. I'd wear it."
Others questioned whether the cap could be a sign that the Ferrari driver will introduce a similar special helmet for the race at Interlagos.
Hamilton officially became an honorary citizen of Brazil in November 2022.

"I’d like to say a big, big thank you to everyone here at the house, for all those who’ve moved mountains to make this day possible," the 41-year-old said at the time. "It is honestly the greatest honour for me to be here receiving and accepting this citizenship. I really do feel like now I’m one of you, finally.

"When I arrived here in 2007 [Hamilton’s first F1 season], the love that’s grown, the experiences we’ve had and, particularly 2021 [his charge to victory], knowing you guys were cheering me on the way, it was one of the most special moments of my entire life. I can’t wait for us to continue to strive ahead.

"I really want to dedicate today, this honour, to Ayrton Senna – to Ayrton’s family, to his friends and to his fans. For me, when I was five years old, I saw Ayrton race for the first time, and that was the moment I knew that I wanted to be a world champion, just like him.

"It was then that I knew and learnt about Brazil. It was then that I started to play FIFA as Brazil! But really, through his eyes, I was able to see how passionate Brazilians were, and how deep it goes, the love and passion you have for your country, and how beautiful it is. I’m so excited to spend some more time here."

The 2026 Brazilian Grand Prix is scheduled for 6-8 November and will round out a triple-header starting with the United States Grand Prix from 23-25 October followed by the Mexican Grand Prix from 30 October to 1 November.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.
